description: Minor material amendments (S.73) to vary condition no. 2 (Approved Plans), 3 (Demolition and Site Clearance), 7 (Cycle Parking Spaces),  9 (Site Wide Car and Cycle Parking Management Strategy), 10 (Foundation Method Statement), 11 (Remediation), 13 (Drainage Strategy), 14 (Piling Method Statement),15 (Refuse and Recycling), 19 (Ultra-low Boilers), 22 (Passenger Lifts), 26 (Business Hours), 27 (Commercial Units Use Class), 28 (Bat Survey Report), 29 (BREEAM), 30 (Sustainability Measures), 32 (Dwelling Energy Performance Certificates), 33 (Commercial Spaces Energy Performance Certificates) and 34 (Children's Play Space) pursuant to planning permission reference 171721FUL dated 02.02.2018 as varied by 203596NMA dated 17.09.2020 for 'Construction of buildings comprising residential units (Use Class C3), flexible retail space (Use Class A1/A2) (at ground floor of the building fronting Northfield Avenue), office space (Use Class B1) (at ground and lower ground of the building fronting Northfield Avenue), landscaping, access and servicing, car parking and associated works (following demolition of existing buildings).'  Variation seeks four additional residential units; reduction in non-residential floorspace; decreasing the height of Block A (from 8 storeys to 6 storeys) and increasing the height of Block C from (from 3 and 4  storeys to 4 and 5 storeys); internal alterations to allow for sprinkler tank infrastructure; amendments to the car and cycle parking provision; other associated access and landscape works and varying the legal obligation
